moments.title: Glasgow Commonwealth Games Finale
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow conclude on Sunday with the closing ceremony, marking the end of 11 days of sporting action.

angles.name: Game On, Glasgow!
angles.copy: It's the final push in Glasgow as the Commonwealth Games wrap up this weekend. What's been your standout moment from the Games? #Glasgow2026

angles.name: Closing Ceremony Countdown
angles.copy: All eyes on the OVO Hydro this Sunday as the Commonwealth Games close out with a spectacular ceremony, headlined by Simple Minds! Who's been glued to the action?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has broken a 73-year record, becoming the longest-running UK #1 single with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK #1 single ever, hitting 19 weeks! Has it been on repeat for you?

angles.name: 73-Year Record Smashed
angles.copy: Moving a 73-year-old record! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean has officially outlasted Frankie Laine's 'I Believe' for weeks at #1. An incredible feat!

moments.title: AIG Women's Open concludes
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open golf tournament wraps up this Sunday, August 2nd, at Royal Lytham & St Annes.

angles.name: Golf Grand Finale
angles.copy: It's Championship Sunday at the AIG Women's Open! Who are you backing to lift the trophy at Royal Lytham & St Annes? #AIGWO
